description: This file defines the class VTUpdateFieldsTask, which extends VTTask and implements functionality to update fields for an entity in vtiger CRM workflows. It includes methods for retrieving field names and performing the task of updating specified fields based on mapping data, utilizing vtiger CRM internal utilities and expression evaluation.

classes.name: VTUpdateFieldsTask
classes.description: A class that extends VTTask to perform field updates on CRM entities according to a specified mapping during workflow execution.

methods.name: getFieldNames
methods.description: Returns the list of field names that this task can update, in this case 'field_value_mapping'.

methods.name: doTask
methods.description: Executes the task: updates entity fields based on the mapping, evaluates expressions, handles different data types, and saves the entity.
